items.title: Nvidia (NVDA) Stock Fair Value Falls After Analysts Reassess Leadership And Regulatory Risks
items.summary: Analysts have reset their fair value estimate for Nvidia from about US$320 to about US$242, which marks a clear change in how the stock’s long term potential is being framed. This shift comes alongside fresh Street research that points to renewed confidence in Jensen Huang’s leadership and AI execution, while still flagging governance and regulatory risks that could influence how closely market prices track these updated targets. As you read on, you will see how these moving pieces fit...
